en: Dependent on a state that is not derived and is wholesome, there arises a state that is not derived and is unwholesome by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*)... Three [results] under root-condition... up to three under non-disappearance condition (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is not derived and is unwholesome, there arises a state that is not derived and is neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome by way of root-condition... Three under root-condition... up to three under non-disappearance condition. (The indeterminate root is only one according to the mode of condition.)
